title: 1-M8 Smoke Grenade

fields.description: Smoke grenade used by western forces. Comes in many different colors, it can provide cover or mark positions.

intro: The 1-M8 Smoke Grenade is a type of smoke grenade in DayZ. While intended to be thrown, the 1-M8 Smoke Grenade can also be combined with a tripwire to create a makeshift alarm, alerting you to oncoming enemies.

title: 40mm Explosive Grenade

fields.name: 40mm Explosive Grenade
fields.description: Ammunition for grenade launchers. Explodes on impact.

intro: The 40mm Explosive Grenade is a type of grenade that can be fired from a grenade launcher. It can quite commonly be found in higher tier military bases.

title: 6-M7 Frag Grenade

fields.description: Fragmentation grenade type used by western forces. It is lethal in small radius, but it can cause serious injuries at medium ranges.

intro: The 6-M7 Frag Grenade is a type of explosive weapon in the DayZ. Intended to be thrown, typically used to eliminate groups of survivors or infected.

title: 6P9 Makarov PB

fields.description: A compact, easy to operate, and highly accurate, suppressed pistol which was based on the Makarov pistol design.

intro: The 6P9 Makarov PB is a type of weapon in DayZ. It has not yet been implemented.

title: 8-M4 Flashbang

fields.description: Stun grenade used to temporarily overload senses of the enemy combatant, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable.

intro: The 8-M4 Flashbang is a non-lethal explosive device in DayZ. Used to temporarily disorient an enemy's senses, it is designed to produce a blinding flash of light and loud noise without causing permanent injury.

title: AUR A1

fields.description: A selective fire bullpup weapon. The compact design and the short barrel make the weapon suitable for CQB. It's fed by a dedicated magazine. Uses 5.56x45mm rounds.

intro: The AUR A1 is a firearm in DayZ.

title: AUR AX

fields.description: A selective fire bullpup weapon. A modern variant of the AUR A1. The railing on the top and the magazine docking system have been adapted to work with standard western accessories.

title: BK-12

fields.description: An old break-action shotgun, also known as the "Spartan". Very effective deterrent against wildlife and other threats. Chambered in 12ga.

intro: The BK-12 is a break-action shotgun in DayZ.

title: BK-133

fields.description: Six shot pump action shotgun fed from internal magazine. Good for hunting dangerous game. Uses both 12ga bucks and slugs.

intro: The BK-133 is a shotgun in DayZ.

title: BK-18

fields.description: Single shot break action hunting rifle. Designed with simplicity, built to last. Uses 7.62x39mm rounds.

intro: The BK-18 is a hunting rifle in DayZ.

title: BK-43

fields.description: Double-barreled break-action shotgun. Old and reliable design, capable of firing both barrels simultaneously. Uses both 12ga bucks and slugs.

intro: The BK-43 is a shotgun in DayZ.

title: Barbed Baseball Bat

fields.description: Baseball bat wrapped with barbed wire. It brings a world of hurt to the poor souls on the receiving end. No Exceptions

intro: The Barbed Baseball Bat is a type of melee weapon in DayZ. It is a more deadly version of the Baseball Bat, created by combining one with Barbed Wire. By adding barbed wire, the bat is now capable of inflicting much worse injuries on your enemies.

title: Baseball Bat

fields.description: A wooden baseball bat made for hitting baseballs. Or, if there are none around, any suitable substitute.

intro: The Baseball Bat is a type of melee weapon in DayZ. It is a wooden club commonly used for playing baseball. It can be found at almost any residential/civilian location.

title: Birch Broom

fields.name: Birch Broom
fields.description: Handmade sweeping untensil. The design is old, but still effective to scare children.

intro: The Birch Broom is a type of weapon in DayZ. It was implemented in the DayZ 1.12 update for the Walpurgis Event that spanned between April 29, 2021, and May 16, 2021.

title: Bizon

fields.description: Selective-fire submachine gun, fed from an unusual cylindrical magazine. Pistol caliber bullets allow low recoil and long sustained fire. Uses .380 ACP rounds.

intro: The Bizon is a firearm in DayZ.

title: Blaze

fields.rateoffire: High (2 shots single); Low (1 shot double)
fields.description: Double-barreled break-action rifle loaded with two .308 WIN rounds.

intro: The Blaze is a type of in DayZ. Its low recoil and dual barrel configuration allows for immediate follow-up shots making it capable of engaging targets at medium range with ease. The same attributes make it semi-effective in close quarters, limited mostly by having to reload after two shots.

title: Bone Knife

fields.name: Bone Knife
fields.description: Once sharpened, this bone has revealed itself to be a decent knife.

intro: The Bone Knife is a player-crafted tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ.

title: Brass Knuckles

fields.description: Effective hand-to-hand weapon, easily concealed from unattentive enemies. Makes for nasty surprise afterwards.

intro: Brass Knuckles is a type of blunt melee weapon in DayZ. Although they do little damage compared to other melee weapons, they are quite hard to see when equipped in a player's hands, making them extremely useful when you are being robbed or need to neutralize a player without killing them.

title: Broom

fields.name: Broom
fields.description: A cleaning tool consisting of stiff fibbers attached to, and roughly parallel to, a cylindrical handle, the broomstick. Mostly used to clean floors, also useful for getting rid of spider webs and scaring away animals.

intro: The Broom is a type of weapon in DayZ. It can also be used as a Torch for a source of light, or broken into sticks. The Damage increses if the broom has been lit. The second damage value in the infobox is the damage if lit.

title: CR-527

fields.description: A bolt-action hunting rifle, fed from a detachable magazine. It is light and accurate at intermediate ranges. Uses 7.62x39mm rounds.

intro: The CR-527 is a hunting rifle in DayZ.

title: CR-550 Savanna

fields.description: A bolt-action rifle, fed from a detachable magazine. Sturdy and built to last. Uses .308 WIN rounds.

intro: The CR-550 Savanna is a bolt-action rifle in DayZ.

title: CR-61 Skorpion

fields.description: Compact selective-fire submachine gun, fed from a detachable magazine. Often used as a sidearm. Uses .380 ACP rounds.

intro: The CR-61 Skorpion is a select-fire submachine gun in DayZ, commonly referred to as just the Skorpion. Found occasionally in Police Stations around Chernarus, the CR-61 Skorpion is a small, tier 2 submachine gun chambered in .380 ACP Rounds. The CR-61 offers a blistering 900 rounds per minute fire rate, which is unfortunately held back by its minuscule 20 round magazine. This weapon is often a sur

title: CR-75

fields.description: Semi-automatic pistol, fed from a detachable magazine. Popular due to good quality and affordable price. Uses 9×19mm rounds.

intro: The CR-75 is a handgun in DayZ.

title: Claymore

fields.description: Directional remote controlled mine. A convenient label reminds the user to point it toward the enemy.

intro: The Claymore is a type of explosive weapon in the DayZ. Intended to be placed and remote detonated.

title: Cleaver

fields.name: Cleaver
fields.description: A big, heavy, sharp knife. Designed to slash through thick raw meat. It can also crack bones easily. Mostly used by butchers.

intro: The Cleaver is bladed melee weapon in DayZ. It was added v0.52 on 19 Dec 2014.

title: Combat Knife

fields.description: Sharp combat knife with a sturdy blade and a handle. Great for self-defense, but it has other, more mundane uses as well.

intro: The Combat Knife is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ.

title: Crowbar

fields.description: Standard curved crowbar. Read instructions before use. May cause injuries if handled improperly.

intro: The Crowbar is a tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ.

title: Crude Machete

fields.name: Crude Machete
fields.description: A quite solid machete with a sharp blade. Although it looks like scrap metal it's a very efficient cutting tool.

intro: The Crude Machete is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.13 Experimental patch on 17th June 2021.

title: DMR

fields.description: Semi-automatic rifle, loaded from a detachable magazine. It has a rail that allows for the use of Western-made scopes. It's suitable for long-range precision, but has a significant kick when shot in quick succession. Uses .308 WIN rounds.

title: Deagle

fields.description: Large, semi-automatic pistol, fed from a detachable magazine. Equipped with railed barrel, it hits way above its weight. Uses .357 rounds.

intro: The Deagle is a semi-automatic handgun chambered in .357 rounds. Commonly found around towns, it has two variants; a standard silver finish, and an ostentatious gold variant.

title: Derringer

fields.description: Double-barreled break-action pistol. Combines compact dimensions and powerful ammunition. Uses .357 rounds.

intro: The Derringer is a handgun in DayZ.

title: EGD-2 Smoke Grenade

fields.description: Smoke grenade used by eastern forces. Simple, yet effective at providing cover or marking positions.

intro: The EGD-2 Smoke Grenade is a type of smoke grenade in DayZ.

title: EGD-5 Frag Grenade

fields.description: Fragmentation grenade type used by eastern forces. It is lethal in small radius, but it can cause serious injuries at medium ranges.

intro: The EGD-5 Frag Grenade is a type of explosive weapon in the DayZ. While intended to be thrown, typically to eliminate groups of hostiles, the EGD-5 Frag Grenade can also be added to a Tripwire to create an explosive booby trap.

title: Engraved Kolt 1911

fields.description: Semi-automatic pistol, fed from a detachable magazine. This variant had been engraved by an unknown artist. Uses .45 ACP rounds.

intro: The Engraved Kolt 1911 is a type of weapon in DayZ. It is a special version of the Kolt 1911 pistol which is functionally identical but boasts a different visual design, featuring engraved patterns on the slide as well as white grips with skull emblems.

title: FX-45
intro: The FX-45 is a semi-automatic handgun chambered in .45 ACP

title: Fange

fields.name: Fange
fields.description: Handcrafted knife. It seems to be an heirloom of some hunter.

intro: The Fange is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.12 Experimental patch on 1st April 2021.

title: Farming Hoe

fields.name: Farming Hoe
fields.description: A farming hoe also known as the Dutch hoe with a sharp piece of metal at the end of a wooden rod pointing in sharp angle designed to cultivate soil or penetrate any fragile or soft object.

intro: The Farming Hoe is an agriculture tool that can be used to dig up earthworms for fishing bait or it can be used as a weapon. However, its primary use is in horticulture as it provides a means to dig plots for planting seeds. This is particularly useful for players who wish to avoid towns while still being able to have enough food to survive in Chernarus.

title: Field Shovel

fields.name: Field Shovel
fields.description: An entrenching tool is a collapsible spade used by military forces for a variety of military purposes. Survivalists, freedivers, campers, hikers and other outdoors groups have found it to be indispensable in field use.

intro: The Field Shovel is a tool which can be used to dig up worms for fishing bait or be used as a weapon. It can also be used to make a farming plot.

title: Firefighter Axe

fields.description: Firefighter axe is used primarily for breaking down doors and windows. Can be also used for wood cutting or other mundane activities.

intro: The Firefighter Axe is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ.

title: Frying Pan

fields.description: A cast iron pan. Can be used for cooking various ingredients, or as a tool of personal defense.

intro: The Frying Pan is used in a variety of methods to prepare food for consumption. Visit Cooking for detailed instructions.

title: GP-25
intro: The GP-25 is a type of weapon in DayZ. It has not yet been implemented. Mounted onto the bayonet lugs of the rifle, the GP-25 will most likely be featured as an attachment for the KA family of weapons.

title: Groza-4

fields.description: The OTs-14-4A (Groza-4) is a combined assault rifle and grenade launcher in a modular plateform. It was developed in the mid-90s for the Russian special forces. Its modular design allows easy conversion into different configurations.

intro: The Groza-4 is a type of weapon in DayZ. It has not yet been implemented. A preview was posted to the DayZ Trello board on February 13, 2016, and the weapon and attachments are fully present within the files, albeit non-functioning in-game.

title: Hammer

fields.description: A multi-purpose tool. Mostly thanks to the fact, that, after a while, everything tends to look like a nail.

intro: The Hammer is a tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ.

title: Hatchet

fields.description: Single-handed bladed tool with a hammer head on one side. Except for chopping wood, it has a wide array of uses.

intro: The Hatchet is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ.

title: Hunting Knife

fields.description: This hunting knife is used during hunting to skin animals and cut up the meat.

intro: The Hunting Knife is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ. The Hunting Knife, along with the Combat Knife and the Steak Knife, has the distinctive ability to be stored inside of Military Boots, saving inventory space or, if used as the primary melee weapon, making the player's profile smaller. This ability, combined with its solid damage output and multiple uses as a tool, make the

title: IJ-70

fields.description: Semi-automatic pistol, fed from a detachable magazine. Produced in large quantities. Uses standard .380 Auto rounds.

intro: The IJ-70 is a semi-automatic handgun chambered in .380 ACP. Commonly found around towns and villages in Chernarus, this is often a survivor's first firearm.

title: Ice Axe

fields.name: Ice Axe
fields.description: An ice axe is a multi-purpose hiking and climbing tool used by mountaineers both in the ascent and descent of routes that involve frozen conditions with snow and/or ice. An ice axe can be held and employed in a number of different ways, depending on the terrain encountered.

intro: The Ice Axe is a type of weapon and piece of equipment in DayZ.

title: Improvised Explosive

fields.description: A clever design that combines the desire for destruction with the user's need for safety.

intro: The Improvised Explosive is a type of explosive weapon in DayZ. Improvised explosives are able to be crafted with the use of an Electrical Repair Kit and Protective Case. The case can be outfitted with all variations of grenades as well as Plastic Explosives. Timers using the Alarm Clock and Remote Detonation Units can be used with the explosives.

title: Improvised Grenades
intro: The Improvised Grenades were a type improvised explosive devices previously in DayZ, shown off in the Rezzed 2013 Developer Sessions presentation on the 23rd June 2013.

title: Improvised Spear

fields.description: An improvised weapon made from a sharp rock or bone at the top of a long stick. It may not be durable, but it will definitely get the job done.

intro: The Improvised Spear is player-crafted, bladed melee weapon in DayZ.

fields.description: Surprisingly sharp large machete. It is basically a big knife. Very useful for self-defense.

intro: The Machete is a bladed melee weapon DayZ.

fields.description: Tool used to tenderize slabs of meat in preparation for cooking. Although the head is heavy and resistant, the handle may not stand up to excessive force.

intro: The Meat Tenderizer is a melee weapon in DayZ. It can also be used as a hammer for Base Building, as well as a tool for opening canned food.

title: Pickaxe

fields.description: As a digging tool, a pickaxe can indeed be used to dig, mine, or even defend oneself if needed.

Often overlooked for its large size and perceived lack of functionality, the Pickaxe deals some of the highest amount of damage in melee combat. With a range matching both the Firefighter Axe and Splitting Axe, the Pickaxe is a dangerous weapon.

title: Pipe Wrench

fields.name: Pipe Wrench
fields.description: Adjustable wrench. Once used for turning nuts or bolts, now it makes a decent blunt weapon.

intro: The Pipe Wrench is a type of melee weapon in DayZ. It can no longer be used to repair engines in vehicles as of V1.19.

title: Pitchfork

fields.name: Pitchfork
fields.description: Agricultural tool composed of a long handle and thick prongs at one end. Used to lift and pitch hay, straw or leaves. Quite capable of piercing through soft materials.

intro: The Pitchfork is a weapon in DayZ. It can also be used for opening canned food.

title: Plastic Explosive

fields.name: Plastic Explosive
fields.description: Industrial explosive. Useless on its own, but can be combined with a trigger device to create a powerful explosion.

intro: Plastic Explosive is a type of explosive weapon in DayZ. It is intended to be combined with a Remote Detonation Unit.

title: Pliers

fields.description: Metal tool with head resembling jaws. Definitely useful for wire cutting and some light bending.

intro: The Pliers is a multi-purpose tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ. They are an essential tool to build gates from fences (after adding a metal wire), thus a very important tool for base building. Not so easily found.

title: Police Baton

fields.name: Police Baton
fields.description: A short metal rod with rubber used as a weapon by police officers.

intro: The Police Baton is a blunt melee weapon in DayZ. It was used by the Chernarus Police pre-outbreak.

title: R12

fields.scopes: [Baraka Sights], [RVN Sights], [ATOG 4x32 Scope], [ATOG 6x48 Scope], [Marksman Scope], [Combat Sights]
fields.description: Seven-shot tactical semi-automatic shotgun fed from an internal magazine. Handy in intense close-quarters engagements. Uses all types of 12ga shotgun shells.

intro: The R12 is a semi-automatic shotgun in DayZ, added in Update 1.28.

title: RAK-37

fields.description: A fully automatic submachine gun with the characteristics of a self-loading pistol. It is fed from a small detachable magazine and uses .380 ACP rounds.

intro: The RAK-37 is a submachine gun in DayZ, re-added to the game in the 1.28 Experimental Patch.

title: RPG-7

fields.description: Powerful. Cheap. Simple. Robust. The RPG-7 is undoubtedly the most famous anti-tank rocket launcher ever devised since its introduction in 1961.

intro: The RPG-7 is a type of weapon in DayZ. It has not yet been implemented. It was teased by Lead Designer Peter Nespesney on Oct 20, 2015.

title: Red 9

fields.description: World War 1 era pistol with integral 10 round magazine.

intro: The Red 9 is a semi-automatic handgun in DayZ. It was removed in 0.63 and is awaiting reimplementation.

title: Revolver

fields.description: Six shot double-action revolver. Compared to pistols, it is relatively slow to load and requires frequent maintenance. On the plus side, it can deliver exceptional damage at short to medium ranges. Uses .357 rounds.

intro: The Revolver is a handgun in DayZ.

title: SG5-K

fields.rateoffire: Very High (~900 rounds/min (Full-Auto)); Very High (~900 rounds/min (3-Round Burst)); Medium (~480 rounds/min (Semi-Auto))
fields.zeroing: 25m (Hip-Fire/Iron Sights); 25m - 100m ((25m default) [Combat Sights]/[RVN Sights]); 25m - 200m ((25m default) [Baraka Sights]); 100m - 600m ((100m default) [ATOG 4x32 Scope]); 100m - 800m ((100m default) [ATOG 6x48 Scope]); 100m - 700m ((100m default) [NV-PVS4 Scope])
fields.description: Selective-fire submachine gun, fed from a detachable magazine. Very high rate of fire. Uses 9×19mm rounds.

intro: The SG5-K is a select-fire submachine gun in DayZ.

title: SK 59/66

fields.description: A ten-shot semi-automatic rifle, fed from an internal magazine. Older model, but still reliable. Uses 7.62x39mm rounds.

intro: The SK 59/66 is a semi-automatic rifle in DayZ. Featuring a 10-round internal magazine, the SK 59/66 is a mid-game, mid-range, tier 3 rifle chambered in 7.62x39mm.

title: SK 59/66 Bayonet

fields.description: A bayonet for SK 59/66 rifle with a bayonet lug.

intro: The SK 59/66 Bayonet is a weapon attachment in DayZ.

title: SSG 82

fields.description: A bolt-action sniper rifle fed from a detachable magazine. Designed to be used by law enforcement in urban environments. Uses 5.45x39mm rounds.

intro: The SSG 82 is a sniper rifle in DayZ. It was added in the 1.19 Experimental Patch.

title: SVAL

fields.zeroing: 160m (Hip-Fire/Iron Sights); 25m - 100m ((25m default) [Combat Sights]/[RVN Sights]); 25m - 200m ((25m default) [Baraka Sights]); 100m - 600m ((100m default) [ATOG 4x32 Scope]); 100m - 800m ((100m default) [ATOG 6x48 Scope]); 100m - 700m ((100m default) [NV-PVS4 Scope])
fields.location: Military Tier 5 Dynamic Events:; Convoys, Helicopter Crash Sites
fields.description: A derivative of the VSS, outfitted to support universal attachments. Uses 9x39mm rounds.

intro: The SVAL is an assault / marksman rifle in DayZ.

title: Sawed-off BK-12

fields.description: Sawed-off old break-action shotgun, also known as the "Spartan". Very effective deterrent against wildlife and other threats. Chambered in 12ga.

intro: The Sawed-off BK-12 is a shotgun in DayZ. It was added in Update 1.19.

title: Sawed-off BK-43

fields.description: Sawed-off double-barreled break-action shotgun. Old and reliable design, capable of firing both barrels simultaneously. Uses both 12ga bucks and slugs.

intro: The Sawed-off BK-43 is a shotgun in DayZ.

title: Sawed-off Blaze

fields.rateoffire: High (2 shots single); Low (1 shot double)
fields.description: Sawed-off double-barreled break-action rifle loaded with two .308 WIN rounds.

intro: The Sawed-off Blaze is a sawed-off two-shot rifle in DayZ. Created from a Blaze and a Hacksaw, the Sawed-off Blaze is a concealable, early-game, high end rifle chambered in .308 WIN Rounds.

title: Sawed-off LE-MAS

fields.description: A bullpup assault rifle, designed to be compact and sustain a high rate of fire. The F1 variant supports semi-auto, burst and full auto modes. The handle has been sawed-off for some reason. It's fed by a dedicated detachable magazine. Uses 5.56x45mm rounds.

intro: The Sawed-off LE-MAS is an automatic rifle in DayZ, crafted by sawing off a LE-MAS. It was added in patch 1.15.

title: Sawed-off Mosin 91/30

fields.description: Sawed-off five shot bolt-action rifle, fed from internal magazine. Still usable today due to its sturdiness. Uses 7.62x54mmR rounds.

intro: The Sawed-off Mosin 91/30 is a sawed-off bolt-action rifle in DayZ. The Sawed-off Mosin 91/30 is created using a Mosin 91/30 and a Hacksaw and is chambered in 7.62x54mmR.

title: Sawed-off Revolver

fields.description: Sawed-off six shot double-action revolver. Compared to pistols, it's relatively slow to load and requires frequent maintenance. On the plus side, it can deliver exceptional damage at short to medium ranges. Uses .357 rounds.

intro: The Sawed-off Revolver is a handgun in DayZ.

title: Screwdriver

fields.description: Regular screwdriver. Can be gently inserted into a screw, or into somebody's jugular.

intro: Screwdriver is a tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ. A rather bad weapon, the Screwdriver lacks both damage and range which makes it a poor choice for a primary melee weapon. Also lacking in functionality, only able to cut some restraints and open canned food, the Screwdriver is really only useful to freshly spawned players.

title: Shovel

fields.description: Ordinary shovel. Strong, steel blade easily splits both soil and skulls.

intro: The Shovel is a multi-purpose tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ.

title: Sickle

fields.name: Sickle
fields.description: A hand-held agricultural tool with a curved blade. Typically used for harvesting grain crops or cutting succulent forage.

intro: The Sickle is a type of weapon in DayZ.

title: Signal Pistol

fields.description: Simple breech loaded signal pistol. Launching flares at long distances, it can be a handy tool for communication, orientation, or just illumination. Uses flare cartridges.

intro: The Signal Pistol is a piece of equipment in DayZ. This gun is used to fire Flares to create a source of light. Once fired, a flare will hang in the air for a short time and light up the area around it in a glow dependent on the cartrige colour. Once it reaches the ground, it extinguishes and the light source goes out shortly after.

title: Sledgehammer

fields.description: Flat metal head can apply more force than other hammers, due to its large size. Certainly useful for various demolition purposes.

intro: The Sledgehammer is a tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ.

title: Splitting Axe

fields.description: Useful for splitting wood or other objects, including closed cans and an occasional forehead.

intro: The Splitting Axe is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ. As of 1.0, the Splitting Axe has surpassed its brother, the Firefighter Axe, in terms of damage and is second only to the Pickaxe. Equal in range to both, the Splitting Axe is a deadly melee weapon. In addition to having all of the same functionality the Firefighter Axe provides, the Splitting Axe boasts more durability in i

title: Sporter 22

fields.description: Semi-automatic rifle, fed from a detachable magazine. Great for recreational activities, like target shooting, plinking, and even small-game hunting. Uses .22 LR rounds.

intro: The Sporter 22 is a semi-automatic rifle chambered for .22 LR Rounds. The damage incurred by the low-velocity .22 LR rounds is very low, resulting in several shots to the body being necessary to kill an infected human. It may take two head shots to put down any target. However, the benefits given in return are very low noise and seemingly near-to-none recoil. This allows for very fast follow-up sh

title: Steak Knife

fields.description: A sharp table knife, used for cutting steak. Serrated blade cuts any meat with ease.

intro: The Steak Knife is a multipurpose tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ. The Steak Knife, along with the Hunting Knife and the Combat Knife, has the distinctive ability to be stored inside of Assault Boots, saving inventory space or, if used as the primary melee weapon, making the player's profile smaller. While it has the same damage as the Kitchen Knife, it has a slightly shorter

title: Stone Knife

fields.name: Stone Knife
fields.description: A shard of stone. Not very durable or sharp, but useful, if you have nothing else at hand.

intro: The Stone Knife is a player-crafted tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ. It can be crafted from a small stone sharpened against a rock or boulder (in the landscape) or sharpened using another small stone.

title: Stun Baton

fields.name: Stun Baton
fields.description: Similar in basic design to an electric cattle prod. It has a metal end split into two parts electrically insulated from each other. At the other end of the shaft are a handle and a switch. Both electrodes must touch the subject.

intro: The Stun Baton is a powered melee weapon in DayZ. It was first found in the files of Experimental patch 0.49 in August 2014, and was spawning between 0.49 and 0.62 patches. It is currently awaiting reimplementation.

title: Sword

fields.name: Sword
fields.description: Faithful replica of a medieval sword. Still sharp and deadly.

intro: The Sword is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ. The Sword can be found in historical locations on Chernarus and in hunting locations on Livonia<ref>Also really good and rare</ref>

title: Telescopic Baton

fields.description: Expandable baton, composed of a cylindrical outer shaft containing telescoping inner shafts that lock into each other when expanded.Portable and dangerous. Open with a flick of the wrist.

intro: The Telescopic Baton is a blunt melee weapon in DayZ. It was first found in the files in Experimental patch 0.49 in August 2014, and was spawning between 0.49 and 0.62 patches. It is currently awaiting reimplementation.

title: Tire Iron

fields.description: Heavy blunt implement. Also an useful tool for getting wheels off the car for maintenance.

intro: The Tire Iron is a blunt weapon in DayZ. Used to lock/unlock tires to vehicles as well as separate the M3S Dual Wheel into two different tires.

title: Tripwire

fields.description: A passive mechanism, Designed to trigger a device when the wire is pulled

intro: The Tripwire is a type of equipment in DayZ.

fields.description: Selective-fire submachine gun fed from a detachable magazine. High caliber makes up for slower fire rate. Uses .45 ACP rounds.

intro: The USG-45 is a select-fire submachine gun in DayZ. Infrequently found in military installations around Chernarus, the USG-45 is a mid-sized, tier 3 submachine gun chambered in .45 ACP.

title: VS-89

fields.description: Bolt-action sniper rifle of the highest precision. With the possibility of attaching scopes, it is perfect for engagement in long-range combat. Uses 7.62x54mmR rounds.

intro: The VS-89 is a bolt-action sniper rifle in DayZ. It was added in the 1.25 Experimental Patch.

intro: The VSD is a late-game, military marksman/sniper rifle in DayZ. Largely considered to be an "end-game" weapon, the VSD is chambered in 7.62x54mmR Rounds.

intro: The Vaiga is a magazine-fed, selective fire shotgun in DayZ.

title: Vikhr

fields.description: A compact firearm heavily influenced by the ASVAL and VSS. It can carry side-mounted optics but lacks an integral suppressor. Uses 9x39mm rounds.

intro: The Vikhr is an assault rifle in DayZ. It was added in the 1.24 Experimental Patch on 16th January 2024.

title: Wrench

fields.description: Adjustable metal wrench made for dealing with fasteners. Small enough to be used in tight space.

intro: The Wrench is a tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ. Vehicles parts like the hood, trunk and doors can be locked with this tool.
